summary: Completed UX enhancements testing for Creabase platform. All 5 new UX features are working correctly: Contact Modal, Creator Selector, Enhanced Chat, Skeleton Loaders, and Empty States.

issues: Orders page uses simpler empty state instead of new EmptyState component with SVG illustrations - consider updating for consistency

critical_code_review_comments: All new UX components are well-structured with proper animations
ContactModal properly handles subscription states (active vs free users)
CreatorSelector has good search functionality with debounced API calls
EmptyState component is reusable with multiple illustration types
Skeleton loaders use proper animate-pulse for loading states
Chat page properly groups messages by date with 'Today'/'Yesterday' labels
seed_data_creation: Created test user with active subscription for UX testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UX enhancements tested and working. Contact Modal shows creator preview, contact info with copy buttons, and usage tracking. Creator Selector dropdown works with search. Chat has date separators and typing indicator. Empty states show SVG illustrations. Skeleton loaders display during loading.

contact_modal.details: Opens when clicking View Contact, shows creator preview (name, image, followers), displays email/phone with copy buttons, shows Monthly Usage tracking (X/25 views), has Done button to close. Animations (fadeIn, slideUp) working correctly.

creator_selector.details: In project creation form, shows 'Click to select a creator...' button. Opens dropdown with search input, displays creators with profile images and follower counts. Selected creator shows in green box with X button to clear. Replaces manual creator_id input.

enhanced_chat.details: Header shows other user avatar, name, and follower count. Date separators show 'Today'/'Yesterday'. Messages have timestamps. Typing indicator component exists (shows during sending). Empty state shows personalized message with creator name.

skeleton_loaders.details: GridSkeleton component exists and is used in Dashboard.js during loading. CardSkeleton, TableRowSkeleton, MessageSkeleton, ProfileSkeleton all properly defined with animate-pulse.

empty_states.details: EmptyState component with SVG illustrations for: creators, messages, projects, orders, search. Shows on Projects page ('No projects yet'), Chat page ('Start the conversation'). Has action buttons (Create Project, Browse Creators).

animations_verified.fadeIn: Used in messages and modal backdrop

known_limitations.clipboard_copy: Copy to clipboard fails in automated testing environment due to browser security restrictions - this is expected and not a code bug
